changes: Biome vegetation appears on 97 eligible outdoor maps. Coastal grasses and thrift-like flowers, moorland heather, woodland ferns/bells, meadow flowers, dry scrub, alpine tufts and waterside reeds use distinct procedural art and density profiles. Fully wet and paved maps remain bare where there is no suitable ground.

Dacia (Transylvania) and outdoor Night Court grounds share map 777’s original pale flower art, fern undergrowth and blue night-sky colors. Existing time rules, mountain geometry, villages and story are unchanged. Map 777 and its cottage/cave remain unchanged.

Vegetation stays off water, roads, painted interiors, structural slabs, stairs, entrances and authored NPC spaces. Flat natural plateaus use the correct world height, with step/cliff edges clear. Nearby forage plants are kept visible. Scenery has no collision, AI, save-state or server payload.

Plant generation happens on map load; only the current map is retained. Cached art, spatial chunks, distance/frustum culling and the existing 220/360/520/720 graphics-tier limits bound the visible plant cost.

Safe rooms have a transparent wooden door frame and an open hinged leaf rendered as fixed world planes. Passage tile is floor 0, so players and allies can cross without a roll or dialogue. Hostile exclusion, protected spawn and return portal remain.
Client repairs legacy and same-instance room thresholds and updates the cached map; the server emits the matching version-2 refuge. Existing save progress is preserved.

Ordinary generated-realm wall destruction is restored when the layer table is used solely for plant occlusion. Magical barriers, refuge walls, map borders and authored layered structures retain protection. No new general building-destruction system is introduced.
Current-version devlog updated and older entries condensed. No dependencies added. Existing 160×160 generated biome blend retained; full continent generation remains pending.

validation.method: Actual script startup and UI logic in jsdom with stubbed canvas/audio and in-process socket-shaped transport. Every eligible map checked for vegetation placement and read-only geography. Full server VM with network/model/persistence disabled. Real generated terrain tested across 108 seed/theme combinations. Player collision sampled across the doorway both ways, with actual NPC movement and hostile exclusion checks. No browser, raster, phone FPS or live LLM result claimed.

limitations: Phone rendering and frame rate across the expanded flora coverage still require playtesting. Stubbed canvas checks verify logic and clipping calls, not visual quality or device FPS.
No live multiplayer, model decisions or deployed server behavior was observed.
The 160×160 mixed-biome prototype is retained; the requested continent with distant desert/snow/coast regions, elevation, settlements and dungeons is still pending.
Plants added by this pass are decorative; existing forage herbs keep their usual gathering behavior.
Protected authored structures remain protected. This pass restores ordinary generated-realm breaking rather than adding destructible multi-floor buildings.
nextPass: Phone playtest on Pixel/S9: Dacia flowers during combat; Tintagel low coastal plants and cliff heights; Moors heather; desert and snow variants. Check readable resource plants and entrances.
Generate a new shared realm and reopen a cached old one. Walk into/out of its refuge, use the return portal, and confirm ordinary outside walls break while enemies cannot enter.

Build the larger continent generator as a separate pass: coastlines, highlands, distant snow/desert/woodland/plains, towns and dungeon entrances. Keep map 777 as Suncat’s home and performance reference.
Retain the target ward/status-ring backlog and further guild dialogue playtesting.
